name: Banh xeo nhan hen
summary: A bánh xèo pancake filled with hến mussels, one of the plates on the Thới Sơn orchard table.
howToEat: Order it with the other islet plates at the midday orchard stop.
where: The orchard stops on cù lao Thới Sơn, about 6 km from Mỹ Tho by boat.
seoTitle: Banh xeo nhan hen on Thoi Son
seoDescription: Bánh xèo nhân hến, the mussel pancake on the Thới Sơn orchard table.
